correctness.rationale: Gauss–Markov innovations factorization K=L diag(1,1-a1²,...,1-a_(n-1)²)L^T establishes SPD, and precision Q=K^-1 has explicit tridiagonal coefficients. All K entries are nondecreasing in each a_i and some strictly; its Perron vector is strictly positive, so λmax(K) strictly rises. Sign conjugation DQD makes all entries nonnegative with strictly positive immediate offdiagonals; each entry is nondecreasing and some strictly, hence its Perron root λmax(K^-1) strictly rises as well. Their product κ2 rises in each a_i, proving unique equal-minimum-gap maximizer for fixed n, including n2. The Toeplitz Fourier symbol (1-r²)/(1-2r cosθ+r²) bounds eigenvalues strictly for every finite vector by positive-frequency integral. Constant and alternating trial vectors asymptotically attain upper/lower symbol edges as n grows; ratio supremum coth²(h/(2ell)), never attained at finite n. Solve inequality in r to get exact all-cardinality Γ threshold. Independently verified exact product kernel/precision inversions and eigen extreme monotonicity in 240 small synthetic configurations, distinct from proof.
